content:
maria: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — summarizing the alert-noise action items and owners. Please skim and call out blockers.
aj: Thanks. Can you paste the action list here?
maria: ```
Action items (short):
1) Prune low-signal alerts (metric spikes w/ <2% user impact) — owner @kevin — due 2026-04-01
2) Dedupe/suppression rules (fingerprint grouping + suppression lists) — owner @tara — due 2026-03-29
3) Threshold retune (auto-tune and manual retune for noisy rules) — owner @aj — due 2026-03-26
4) Paging policy update (quiet windows + escalation tweaks) — owner @maria — due 2026-03-30
5) Recurring-incident pattern analysis (correlate alerts -> root cause families) — owner @kevin — due 2026-04-05

Please add your task IDs and any infra access notes.
``` 
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315 closed — postmortem created: https://redwood.pm/inc/INC-2026-0315 :white_check_mark:
kevin: I can take prune + pattern analysis. Need the alert-export csv and a view into alert history (90d). Who has the export job creds?
maria: @ops has the job creds, ops — can you grant kevin read-only to `alerts-export-prod`? :pray:
ops: granted `alerts-export-prod` to kevin for 7 days. Added a short note to the ticket. Will schedule a 30m window if you need a live run.
aj: I'll own the threshold retune. Quick Q: do we also need runbook updates for any alerts we silence? I can add a rollback plan to the PR.
tara: For dedupe rules, I'm planning to implement grouping by `alert_fingerprint` + `source_region` then add suppression entries for known noisy emitters. Will draft suppression list and send PR. Expect initial PR by 3/25.
maria: That sounds good. Proposal: weekly checkpoint sync Mondays 09:00 PT starting next Monday. @aj @tara @kevin ack?
kevin: :thumbsup: ack
aj: ack — I'll update thresholds dashboard and include a changelog in the PR.
tara: I'll open the dedupe PR in `eng-oncall/alerting` and tag reviewers `@maria @aj`.
maria: I've created a tracking board in Asana: https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/board — please add your task IDs to the card and mark dependencies.
aj: added task 3218 (threshold-retune), ETA 2026-03-26
kevin: added tasks 3220 (prune-low-signal) and 3221 (recurring-patterns)
maria: Reminder: if any change affects customer-facing SLAs or increases error noise to paging, escalate to product + support and include a rollback plan in the PR.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook change request created: RB-456 for updates to `alerts/runbooks/thresholds.md`
kevin: Will include rollback script and a smoke-test checklist. Paging changes will include automatic fallback to less noisy route.
ops: I'll coordinate a brief smoke-test window with infra for any kernel-level metric changes. Ping me when you have a PR ready.
maria: One more ask — for noisy metrics collector during maintenance windows, can we schedule suppressions instead of deleting rules? @tara
aj: Good point — scheduled suppression avoids data loss and lets us re-evaluate after the window.
tara: yes, will add scheduled suppression rules in the PR rather than removing alerts.
maria: Thanks everyone. Closing thread for now — please update your Asana card by EOD Thu if you're blocked so we can escalate.
